title: Source Registry Record
description: Immutable evidence metadata. Source bytes live at their original URL or in approved external storage, never in this Git repository.

id.description: Permanent human-readable Source ID assigned once under docs/SOURCE_REFERENCE.md; it never changes or gets reused.

schema_version.description: Version of the Source Registry contract used to validate this metadata record.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when the repository metadata record was first created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time when metadata last changed; changing metadata never changes the immutable archived evidence bytes.

source_ids.description: Must contain this record's own Source ID; additional entries identify antecedent evidence from which this source was reproduced.

confidence_score.description: Current assessment of the source's evidentiary reliability under the five-level confidence policy.

status.description: Registry lifecycle state; registered evidence awaits review, while superseded and deprecated records remain permanently queryable.

notes.description: Optional metadata clarification that does not alter or replace the evidence itself.

title.description: Observed source title, or a precise catalog title when the evidence provides none.

organization.description: Organization principally responsible for the evidence; null when unknown or not applicable.

publication_date.description: Date the evidence was publicly released; null for unpublished or undated material.

document_date.description: Date printed on or intrinsic to the document, which may differ from publication_date; null when absent.

authors.description: Ordered list of credited people or institutional authors; empty when no author is identified.

publisher.description: Publisher, filing authority, platform, or distributor; null when the source has no distinct publisher.

source_type.description: Controlled classification of the evidence medium and publication channel.

source_url.description: Original authoritative URL where evidence was obtained; null for offline evidence. This is distinct from archived storage.

storage_provider.description: External provider holding archived evidence bytes; Google Drive is supported but not required.

storage_location.description: Provider-specific folder path or stable external location for the archived object; never a path inside this Git repository.

external_file_id.description: Immutable provider-assigned object identifier, such as a Google Drive file ID; null when storage_provider is none.

original_filename.description: Filename of the archived bytes at ingestion, retained for identification; null when no external archive exists.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the archived object, such as application/pdf; null when no bytes are archived.

file_size_bytes.description: Exact archived-object size in bytes used for integrity checks; null when no archived object exists.

cryptographic_hash.description: Lowercase hexadecimal digest of immutable archived bytes; null when bytes cannot legally or technically be archived.

hash_algorithm.description: Algorithm used for cryptographic_hash; null exactly when no digest is recorded.

archived_at.description: UTC date-time when immutable bytes were placed in external storage; null when no archive exists.

archive_access_status.description: Current access classification of the externally archived object; null when storage_provider is none. It does not grant permissions.

copyright_status.description: Rights assessment governing retention and use; metadata-only records are allowed when bytes cannot be archived.

version.description: Publisher-assigned edition, revision, accession, or version label; null when the evidence has no version.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the primary content language.

access_restrictions.description: Human-readable legal, subscription, confidentiality, or operational access conditions; null when unrestricted.

reliability_notes.description: Evidence-specific reliability assessment, including conflicts, transcription limits, or image-quality constraints; null when none.

superseded_by_source_id.description: Source ID of the direct replacement for this evidence record; null until superseded.

supersedes_source_ids.description: Source IDs directly replaced by this record; empty when this evidence replaces nothing.
